requirements.summary: Exactly two allowlisted operations: portainer EndpointList and portainer docker_proxy path /containers/json; Proxmox/OPNsense excluded.
Default projection on both paths with ONE disclosure schema {v,applied,entry,mode,fields,reason?}; fields=[] when nothing applied, entry="" when no match; whole upstream_result re-derived.
Explicit full via call_tool returns unprojected objects; direct-path opt-out via call_tool projection.full; ceiling preserved.
Field selection overrides defaults, raw keys, unknown fields reject on non-empty lists, empty list+fields accepted, fields:[] rejected; bounds + runtime-derived budget; full XOR fields.
Allowlist entries explicit identities justified by captured schemas/payloads; no patterns; non-matching docker_proxy paths labeled not_allowlisted.

Errors, empty lists, carrier failures, non-empty aggregate all-defaults-missing, non-object items, direct collisions degrade with per-row disclosure channels; forged members never bridge-authoritative.
Non-allowlisted tools and calls with no projection request byte-identical including page splits on both paths; disclosure metadata only when budget admits; engine decision out-of-band.
